Serenity Villa

Interior Design

Bangalore, India

2025

Service

Interior Design

Location

Bangalore, India

Area

4,500 sq ft

Year

2025

The client dreamed of a quiet haven where natural textures, light, and open spaces could speak in harmony. A home that would feel as calm on a hectic Tuesday evening as it does on a slow Sunday morning.

We brought that vision to life using raw timber accents, polished stone surfaces, and a restrained material palette anchored in warm neutrals. Every spatial decision — from the ceiling height of the central living area to the placement of a single pendant light — was made in service of the same feeling: unhurried serenity.
